name: ANSI N42.34-2006 clause 7.1 ambient-temperature influence test of an externally powered handheld radionuclide identifier from -20 C to +50 C
plain_name: Check a handheld radiation identifier still names radioactive sources correctly from -20 C to +50 C
description: Homeland-security radionuclide-identifier qualification per ANSI N42.34-2006 clause 7.1: the switched-on instrument, powered from an external source, stabilizes at 22 C for 2 h in an environmental chamber, then is stepped at 10 C/h up to +50 C and down to -20 C with 1.5 h stabilization at each 10 C step and 8 h at each extreme, with Am-241/Co-60 identification trials and Cf-252 neutron checks at each plateau. The device envelope used for the size requirements is the ORTEC Detective-X HPGe identifier (39.5 x 16 x 21 cm), which is rated for -20 C to +50 C.
keywords: Check a handheld radiation identifier still names radioactive sources correctly from -20 C to +50 C

sources.citation: ANSI N42.34-2006 American National Standard Performance Criteria for Hand-Held Instruments for the Detection and Identification of Radionuclides (IEEE, 22 January 2007)
ORTEC Detective-X Ultra High Resolution HPGe Radioisotope Identification Device (data sheet)

requirements.rationale: The chamber must cover the full -20 C to +50 C operating range (253.15-323.15 K).
The instrument runs from an external power source while inside the chamber, so a cable port/feedthrough to the test item is needed.
Circumscribed diameter of the Detective-X footprint 39.5 cm x 16 cm (sqrt(395^2 + 160^2) = 426.2 mm, rounded up to 427 mm) must fit the chamber cross-section.
The 21 cm instrument height must fit the chamber's usable height.
The chamber ramps at 10 C/h (166.7 mK/min, rounded up to 167 mK/min); any programmable chamber does this.
Each temperature extreme is held for 8 h with the instrument operating.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
